translation.Statistics.Analysis.Failed_other: {{count}} games were not analysed because of an engine error.
translation.Statistics.Analysis.Help: It starts from the most recent games and saves each one as soon as it is done: you can stop, change page or close the program and resume later where you left off. The statistics update as it goes.
translation.Statistics.Analysis.NoEngine: No engine installed: add one in the Engines page.
translation.Statistics.Analysis.Title: Engine analysis
translation.Statistics.DiffHelp: Difference: points scored minus points expected from the ratings, per 100 games (+10 = 10 points more than predicted). Rows with fewer than 10 games are faded: too few to tell.
translation.Statistics.Engine.ByPhase: Errors by phase of the game
translation.Statistics.Engine.ConversionHelp: Clearly winning: at least two positions in a row at +2 or more for you. Clearly losing: at least two in a row at −2 or worse. The percentage is games won for the first row, points saved for the second.
translation.Statistics.Engine.EndgameExpected: expected from the evaluation on entry: {{expected}} · before: {{previous}}
translation.Statistics.Engine.EndgameHelp: For each endgame the engine's evaluation when it starts (at most 6 queens, rooks, bishops and knights) is compared with the result: the coloured number says how many points per 100 endgames you score above or below what that evaluation promised.
translation.Statistics.Engine.PhaseHelp: Opening: the first 15 moves. Endgame: from when at most 6 queens, rooks, bishops and knights are left. Middlegame: the rest. Inaccuracy, mistake and blunder as in the game report (a loss of 5, 10 or 20 points of winning chances).
translation.Statistics.Engine.TimeTroubleDetail: with less than 10% of the time you play {{moves}} of your moves · before: {{previous}}
translation.Statistics.Engine.WorstErrors: The costliest errors of the period
translation.Statistics.Eval15Help: Average engine evaluation after Black's 15th move, from your point of view (+1.0 = a pawn up). Only analysed games longer than 15 moves count.
translation.Statistics.FirstDownload: Download the account's games to compute the statistics. The last {{days}} days are downloaded (the chosen period and the previous one, for the comparison); the games stay on this computer and later updates only download the new ones.
translation.Statistics.Incomplete: The downloaded games start on {{from}}: they do not cover the whole previous period, so the comparison is partial.
translation.Statistics.Insight.AccuracyBad: Average accuracy dropped to {{accuracy}}% (it was {{previous}}% in the previous period).
translation.Statistics.Insight.AccuracyGood: Average accuracy rose to {{accuracy}}% (it was {{previous}}% in the previous period).
translation.Statistics.Insight.AfterLossBad: After a loss you do worse: {{score}}% in {{n}} games (expected {{expected}}%). A break after losing could earn you points.
translation.Statistics.Insight.AfterLossGood: After a loss you bounce back well: {{score}}% in {{n}} games (expected {{expected}}%).
translation.Statistics.Insight.AfterLossStreakBad: After two or more losses in a row your results drop: {{score}}% in {{n}} games (expected {{expected}}%). Stopping after the second loss would pay off.
translation.Statistics.Insight.AfterLossStreakGood: Even after two losses in a row you hold up: {{score}}% in {{n}} games (expected {{expected}}%).
translation.Statistics.Insight.ComebacksBad: Once clearly worse (−2 or less) you hardly ever save the game: {{wins}} wins and {{draws}} draws out of {{n}} games.
translation.Statistics.Insight.ComebacksGood: You never give up: of the {{n}} games where you were clearly losing (−2 or worse) you won {{wins}} and drew {{draws}}.
translation.Statistics.Insight.ConversionBad: Of the {{n}} games where you were clearly winning (+2 or more) you won only {{share}}%: {{draws}} draws and {{losses}} losses. Converting better is worth more than any opening.
translation.Statistics.Insight.ConversionGood: When you are clearly winning you bring it home: {{share}}% won out of {{n}} games at +2 or more.
translation.Statistics.Insight.EndgamesBad: In endgames you lose {{diff}} points per 100 games against the evaluation you enter them with ({{n}} endgames analysed).
translation.Statistics.Insight.EndgamesGood: In endgames you gain {{diff}} points per 100 games against the evaluation you enter them with ({{n}} endgames analysed).
translation.Statistics.Insight.Eval15Bad: With {{color}}, {{opening}}: after move 15 you stand at {{eval}} on average ({{n}} games analysed).
translation.Statistics.Insight.Eval15Good: With {{color}}, {{opening}} gives you good positions: after move 15 you stand at {{eval}} on average ({{n}} games analysed).
translation.Statistics.Insight.LongSessionBad: You fade in long sessions: from the 4th game in a row you are at {{late}} points against expectation, versus {{early}} in the first three ({{n}} games).
translation.Statistics.Insight.LongSessionGood: You improve in long sessions: from the 4th game in a row you are at {{late}} points against expectation, versus {{early}} in the first three ({{n}} games).
translation.Statistics.Insight.OpeningBad: With {{color}}, {{opening}}: you score {{score}}% in {{n}} games, while the ratings predicted {{expected}}%.
translation.Statistics.Insight.OpeningGood: With {{color}}, {{opening}} works well for you: {{score}}% in {{n}} games, against {{expected}}% expected.
translation.Statistics.Insight.OpponentsStrongerBad: Against stronger opponents (over 50 points above) you do worse than expected: {{score}}% against {{expected}}% ({{n}} games).
translation.Statistics.Insight.OpponentsStrongerGood: Against stronger opponents (over 50 points above) you do better than expected: {{score}}% against {{expected}}% ({{n}} games).
translation.Statistics.Insight.OpponentsWeakerBad: Against weaker opponents (over 50 points below) you drop points: {{score}}% against {{expected}}% ({{n}} games).
translation.Statistics.Insight.OpponentsWeakerGood: Against weaker opponents (over 50 points below) you convert well: {{score}}% against {{expected}}% ({{n}} games).
translation.Statistics.Insight.PhaseErrors: Your serious errors cluster {{phase}}: {{rate}} per 100 moves, against {{other}} in the rest of the game.
translation.Statistics.Insight.TimeLosses: {{share}}% of your losses come on time ({{n}} games).
translation.Statistics.Insight.TimeLossesCompared: {{share}}% of your losses come on time ({{n}} games); in the previous period it was {{previous}}%.
translation.Statistics.Insight.TimeTroubleErrors: {{share}}% of your serious errors come with less than 10% of your time left, though you play only {{moves}}% of your moves there ({{n}} errors).
translation.Statistics.Insight.TrendBad: Worse than the previous period: {{score}}% against {{previous}}%, and {{diff}} fewer points per 100 games against expectation.
translation.Statistics.Insight.TrendGood: Better than the previous period: {{score}}% against {{previous}}%, and {{diff}} more points per 100 games against expectation.
translation.Statistics.NeedsAnalysis: These statistics need the engine analysis of your games: start it from the "Engine analysis" box above. You can look at them while the analysis goes on.
translation.Statistics.NoAccounts: Link a Chess.com or Lichess account in the User page first: the statistics are computed on its games.
translation.Statistics.NoGames: No games in this period with this time control.
translation.Statistics.NoInsights: Nothing worth pointing out: a finding needs at least {{n}} games and a clear difference from what the ratings predict.
translation.Statistics.PeriodText: Period: from {{from}} to {{to}}, compared with the same number of days before.
translation.Statistics.SessionHelp: A session is a run of games with breaks shorter than 30 minutes between them (all time controls count).
translation.Statistics.Subtitle: How your games go: openings, habits and comparison with the previous period.
